proposed_fixes.title: Keep update completion status consistent with the installer result
plan: Trace the 0.95.1 auto-update completion state and identify which component renders the reported message.
Ensure user-facing completion/failure state is tied to the actual bundle result and does not contradict a successful installation.
Add a regression test for an update that completes successfully but encounters a post-install detection warning.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The auto-update path may show a later exception-detection failure after reporting success if its post-install state is derived from a second check or stale updater result.
verification: Repeat the reported update path and verify a successful install does not subsequently display a contradictory failure, while genuine setup failures remain visible.

confidence.rationale: The issue gives a success-then-failure sequence, but the screenshot source and error condition are not yet identified.
